tei:div.tei:p: ༄/ /dpal gur gyi mgon po'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi lag len don gnyer dga' bskyed bar chad kun sel zhes bya ba bzhugs// shrī nā tha bud+dha dh+wa ra ye na ma/ grub pa'i khyu mchog bsod nams dbang po dang / /yab rje sbas pa'i sangs rgyas grags pa'i mtshan/ /rgyal ba mus pa chen por gus btud nas/ /sbyin sreg cho ga don gnyer dga' bskyed spel/ /de la 'dir dpal gur gyi mgon po'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi lag len la sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so/ /dang po gnas ji ltar 'tshams par sa stegs la zhi ba'i thab kyai rdor bzhin chu tshon gyis bris pa'i pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi dbus su nyi dkyil gyi steng du nas nag gam 'bras gang rung gi tshom bu brgyad dbus che ba dang / chung ba bdun g.yon nas brtsams mdun nas g.yas phyogs su cha mnyam nas bkod la kha kher steng du lci ba brtsigs/ shar lhor zan gyi ting lo ras mar dang bcas pa bzhag rang shar du kha bltas pa'i mdun du me yol rdo rje dril bu/ nang mchod/ dgang gzar blug gzar/ bsang chu'i snod 'thor yab dang bcas pa rnams spyi mthun/ g.yas su rang ngos nas brtsams te sreg rdzas yam shing / mar/ yungs kar/ 'bras/ zas mchog so ba/ nas/ gro/ sran ma/ dur ba/ ku sha rnams dang / g.yon du chu gnyis/ sngon 'gro'i mchod pa lnga/ gtor ma dam rdzas gsum mam lnga gang rung dang / bskang gso byed par spro na/ bskang ba'i gtor ma rgyas bsdus gang rigs dang thun gtor bzhi'ang bshams/ me lha'i zlum gtor gcig kyang bshams/ me spor ba'i spor ldeng bya'o/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la bdag bskyed mgon po dpa' rkyang sa los mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs bdud 'joms ltar bsgom la/ dpal 'bar che ba zhig la me sbar te/ yam shing mar la sbags pa'am/ rtswa skam po gzhan dang bcas pas lag pa gnyis kas gus pa'i tshul gyis thab la g.yas nas zlum por bskor zhing / ngag tu yi ge bdun pa lan gsum brjod la/

oṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la ram̐ zhes brjod de thab kyi nang gi ting lo la me gso/ de nas khu tshur gnyis bcangs pa'i mthe bong brkyangs pa byang chub mchog gi phyag rgyas dgang blugs bzung la/ blug gzar mar dang bcas pas dgang gzar gyi kha la reg cing / blug gzar gyi mar bud shing la khyab par blugs te/ oṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la ram̐ zhes brjod/ de nas nang mchod byin rlabs gtor ma ltar byas nas rdo rje'i rtses thab dang yo byad thams cad la gtor/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las a las thod pa dkar po yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du hūm̐ las lha rdzas kyi mchod yon/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa dang / sreg rdzas rnams bgegs dang bar chad zhi ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ ar+gham̐ sogs dang / oṃ shrī swāhā/ oṃ dz+riṃ swāhā/ oṃ oṃ swāhā/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ dharmā ra ṇi sogs brjod cing rol mo dkrol/ thab khung mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las zhi ba'i thab khung dkar po zlum po yangs shing rgya che ba/ kha khyer dang mu ran la rdo rjes mtshan pa'i phyi rol stegs bu gru bzhi pa'i zur bzhir zla phyed rdo rje can/ zhes pas thab bskyed la 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/ me 'bar ba'i dbus su pam̐ las pad+ma dang / ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du ram̐ las bgrang phreng ram̐ gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las me lha ra skyes la zhon pa las zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas bgrang phreng / g.yon spyi blugs 'dzin pa'am yang na phyag bzhi pa g.yas mchog sbyin dang bgrang phreng / g.yon dbyug gu dang spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ lus po me'i rang bzhin dmar po zhal gyi dkyil 'khor dkar po las 'od zer dkar po 'phro ba/ gsus khyim che ba/ ral pa'i thor tshugs can ag tshom 'phyangs pa drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor ba/

de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas shar lho nas me lha drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥzhes dang / lag pa gnyis kyi mthe bong gung mo'i rtsa bar bzhag mdzub mos gung mo'i rgyab nas bkab pa dbyug gu rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya rna ba'i drung du g.yab cing / tshur spyon tshur spyon 'byung po che/ /me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /bsreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du/ /'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol/ /gzi brjid chen po me yi lha/ /'dod pa thams cad sgrub pa po/ /thugs rjes sems can don mdzad pa/ /'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ ak+na ye mahā te dza sarba karmā pra sa dha ka kā ru ṇa kṛ d+ya sa twat+tha/ asmin san+ni he to bha wa oṃ e h+ya hi mahā bhu ta de wa ri ṣi dī dza sat+ta ma gṛ hi twa ā hu ti a ha ra asmin pan+ni hi twa bha wa zhes pas spyan drangs/ pad+ma ka ma la ya satwaṃ zhes brjod la thab tu me tog gnyis phul te/ thab kyi shar lhor pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs par bsam/ spos dang bcas pas rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ oṃ badz+ra a na la mahā bhu ta dz+wa la ya sarba bhismī ku ru sarba duṣ+ṭan hūm̐ phaṭ t+yi sh+ya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hūm̐/ sa ma ya satwaṃ zhes brjod la/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes pas bstim/ slar yang rang gi snying kha'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa ma dzaḥ zhes dang rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas dbang lha spyan drangs la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas sku gang / dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan par bsam/ de nas oṃ ak+na ya sa pa ri wā ra re re'i mgor sbyar ba'i nyer spyod lnga ghaṇ+ṭe ra ṇi rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/

mtshan sngags kyi mthar oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod phul/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras/ /me lha'i rgyal po ḍā kis dbang bskur ba/ /shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad bsreg /'jigs byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud/ /ces pas bstod/ de nas ku sha'i chun po brgyad bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i ku sha sngo ljang rtsa ba dang rtse mo ma nyams pa dwangs shing thog pa med pa thab dang yo byad rnams kyi 'bags pa dang ma dag pa thams cad sel ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur par bsam ste/ oṃ ku sha 'di ni bzang zhing dge /sa las skyes pa'i snying po mchog /tshangs pa yi ni dag byed yin/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi dag byed de/ /de yis bdag la bgegs med cing zhi bar mdzod cig oṃ badz+ra sa satwa a/ zhes brjod de thab kyi mdun nas g.yas skor gyi rim pas phyogs mtshams brgyad du rtse mo g.yas skor du bkram mo/ /de nas gzar bu gnyis byang chub mchog gi phyag rgyas bzung ste/ me lha'i zhal cung zad gdangs pa'i ljags hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las ram̐ bsam ste/ dgang blugs kyi gzar bu'i kha la'ang ram̐ bsam ste/ oṃ ag+na ye swāhā zhes lan bdun brjod cing mar blugs gzar bdun gyis dgang gzar bkang la mthar/ oṃ he ru ka mahā badz+ra sa pa ag+na ye di bya di bya ag+na mahā shrī ye ha bya bā ha na ya sarba pā pam̐ shin+tiṃ ku ru swāhā zhes brjod de gzar bu gnyis kha sbyar la me lha'i zhal du phul bar bsam mo/ /de lta bu lan gsum gyis byon zan phul la bar der me bkra brtag ste ngan na hūm̐ zhes brjod cing bsang chus phyogs kun tu gtor te bgegs bsal lo/ /de nas me tog la sogs pa mchod pa lngas mchod la/ yam shing la sogs 'og nas 'byung ba'i sreg rdzas rnams rim pa bzhin lag g.yon du bzung la g.yas pa'i mtheb srin gyis steng na bslangs shing cung zad bskor te mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgyas dbul/

de'ang yam shing byang chub kyi shing du mos te oṃ bo dhi bh+rik+ṣa ya swāhā/ zhes pa bdun nam nyer gcig la sogs pas phul ba'i mthar oṃ bo dhi bh+rik+ṣa ya/ bdag gi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad dang gsang sngags kyi lhag chad la sogs pa'i nyes pa thams cad shin+tiṃ ku ru swāhā zhes brjod/ de bzhin du 'og ma rnams la'ang de'i rigs pas shes par byas la/ oṃ ag+na ye swāhā zhes pas mar dang / oṃ sarba pā pam̐ da ha na badz+ra ya swāhā zhes pas til lam yungs kar dang / oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭa ye swāhās 'bras dang / oṃ sarba sam̐ pa de swāhās zho dang sbyar ba'i zas mchog dang / oṃ badz+ra bi dzā ya swāhās 'bras so ba dang / oṃ mahā be ga ya swāhās nas dang / oṃ badz+ra ghasma rā ya swāhās gro dang / oṃ mahā ba la ya swāhās sran ma dang / oṃ badz+ra a yu ṣe swāhās durba dang / oṃ a pra ti ha ta badz+ra ya swāhās ku sha rnams phul la sde tshan re re'i mthar gong ltar gyi spel tshig sbyor/ go rim 'di rnams sreg rdzas gshom pa'i skabs su gsungs pa'i go rim bzhin bkod pa lags/ de ltar me lha la sreg rdzas ji tsam 'byor ba phul ba'i mthar/ gong ltar mchod bstod byas la/ oṃ prok+ṣa ṇam̐ pra tits+tsha swāhā zhes pas bsang gtor dang / oṃ i mam̐ ar+gham̐ ma ya dat+ta gṛ ha ṇi sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tsha swāhā zhes pas mchod yon phul la mar blug gzar gang thab tu blugs te/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la ram̐ zhes brjod me lha 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur par bsam mo/ /de nas 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa ni bud shing brtsigs pa las ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i nang du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa ba gur me 'bar ba'i nang dur khrod brgyad kyis bskor ba'i dbus su pad+ma nyi ma mi ro dmar ser mgo g.yas su bstan pa'i steng du hūm̐ las gri gug las mgon po/

g.yon du e ka dza ti'i lto bar lha mo las mgon ru 'dren rnams sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i gtor chog ltar bskyed/ dur khrod brgyad du lha klu phyogs skyong zhing skyong gza' rgyu skar 'jigs byed rgyal chen/ gzhan yang snang srid kyi lha srin sde brgyad dregs pa pho mo'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od 'phros pas/ mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ mgon po sku༞ lha mo sku༞ las mgon kun gshegs kyis spyan drangs/ gnyis su med par thim/ yang 'od 'phros dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la dbang bskur du gsol/ oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ zhes dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso bor mi skyod pa/ 'khor rnams la rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga phyed pa res dbu brgyan/ blo 'khob chung bas gong du ting nge 'dzin gyis me sbar la skabs 'dir dngos su sbor zhes gsungs kyang lag len snga ma bde'o/ /de nas mgon po 'khor bcas kyi ljags hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan zhing / dgang gzar blug gzar gyi kha la ram̐ gyis mtshan pa/ yi ge bdun pa gsum gyis byon zan mar dbul/ dgang blugs kha sbyar nas thab la g.yas su bskor zhing / oṃ mahā kā la ya sa pa ri wa ra bdag gi sdig sgrib las ngan dam tshig nyams chag sngags lhag chad kyi nyes pa thams cad shin+tiṃ ku ru swāhā/ de nas yam shing mar gang 'tshams bcu tshan re/ phul rjes/ yungs kar la bcu cha'i sngags 'bum tsho bdun kha skong 'bum tsho gcig bzlas tshe sbyin sreg khri tsho brgyad de/ zhag gsum la cho ga bzhi byas pa'i cho ga re la sngags khri tsho gnyis re bzla dgos pa las sngags stong phrag gnyis de'i mtshams rnams su rdzas rnams bcu tshan pa re 'bul dgos pa lags/

grangs bzung / gzhan sreg rdzas rnams brgya rtsa re skabs gang bder 'bul/ bar bar du yam shing mar gyis me gso zhing / mthar mar gyis gang ba'i sbyin sreg gsum 'bul/ 'di thams cad la 'bul sngags yi ge bdun pa spel tshig gong ltar kho nas 'bul lo/ /gtor ma bsangs sbyangs byin gyis brlabs/ so so'i sngags kyis phul nas phyi nang gi mchod pa bstod pa 'phrin las 'chol ba rnams rgyas bsdus gang 'os bya'o/ /'di nyi ma bar ma'i snga chog la mdzad/ nyi ma snga rting gnyis dang bar ma'i dgong thun la kyai rdor bde mchog gi gtor bsngo dkyus bzhin grub rjes/ lha brgyad mdun bskyed skabs bskyed zin pas lcam dral gnyis la sngags rnams kyis phul nas/ phyi nang gi mchod pa 'phrin 'chol sogs byas rjes/ zhal bzhi pa man gtor bsngo rgyas pa bshags pa yan sngags 'chang chen po'i gtor chog bzhin byas la/ spro na skabs 'dir bskang gso rgyas bsdus gang rigs bya zhing / srid zhi'i dpal 'byor ma yan bya/ bskang ba mi byed tshe sngags thung gsum nas bstod pa nas/ de yis sangs rgyas rin po che myur du thob par shog gi bar bya/ gsum pa rjes ni yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskang / ma 'byor ba dang sogs bzod gsol/ mdun gyi mgon po lha brgyad rang la thim zhing gzhan rnams badz+ra muḥ de nas thab khung du mar blugs gzar gang dgang gzar la reg pa dang bcas pas blugs la/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la ram̐ zhes brjod de me lha zhal phyag gi rnam pa can du gyur par bsams la sreg rdzas rnams kyi lhag ma bdun nam bcu gcig la sogs pa ci 'byor phul/ mthar byon zan gyi skabs ltar mar dgang blugs gsum gang ba'i sbyin sreg tu phul/ yon bdag la sogs pa'i don du byed na de'i lag pa g.yas pa'i mthe bong dgang gzar dang lhan cig tu bzung la gang ba'i sbyin sreg phul ba'i mthar/ bdag gi yon bdag che ge mo zhes bgyi ba'i nad dang gdon dang /

bkra mi shis pa dang / byur dang skal ba ngan pa thams cad shan+tiṃ ku ru swāhā/ zhes bdun tshan gsum po re re'i mthar bya'o/ /gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa'i mthu phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pas byin gyis brlabs/ lag pa g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya byas te/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra oṃ a ka ro mu kham̐ zhes sogs gsum mam lngas phul/ mtshan sngags re re nas sngon du 'gro ba'i chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pa dang nang mchod/ 'jig rten dbang phyug sogs kyi mthar/ tshangs pa 'jig rten mgon gyi sras/ /me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /'byung po yongs su bskyab pa'i phyir/ /thugs rje dbang gi skur sprul pa/ /rig sngags sgrub pa'i drang srong tshul/ /nyon mongs bsreg pa'i shes rab 'od/ /bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar/ /mngon shes rdzu 'phrul zhabs dang ldan/ /thabs kyi sprul pa'i theg pa chibs/ /rig sngags gsung gi bgrang phreng 'dzin/ /bdud rtsi'i bcud ldan ghun bi bsnams/ /chos kyi bdud rtsi yongs la bsil/ /nyes pa'i skyon bral tshangs par spyod/ /'jig rten gnas kyang mya ngan 'das/ /zhi ba brnyes kyang thugs rje che/ /de bas bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /zhes pas bstod/ drang srong chen po 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyis bdag gi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i zhes sogs 'dod don gsol ba btab/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyis lhag chad kha bskangs la/ oṃ prok+ṣa ṇam̐ pra tīts+tsha swāhās bsang gtor dang / oṃ sarba sam̐ shwa dha ye swāhās 'thor 'thung phul la/ bdag gi don dang gzhan gyi don/ /byin za khyod kyis bsgrub kyi gshegs/ /ji bzhin dus su slar gshegs te/ /bdag gi dngos grub thams cad sgrubs/

/oṃ ag+na ye gats+tsha zhes dang / dbyug gu rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya phyir bkyed de/ me lha rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim par bsams la rang gi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ dge ba bsngo ba dang smon lam bkra shis rgyas par bya'o/ /yo byad gzhan rnams bsdu zhing / me ma shi bar mi reg grub rjes thal ba chu bor dor/ tshul 'di grub mchog dbang po dang / /rgyal ba ma lus bskyed pa'i yab/ /grags pa'i mtshan dang mus chen rje'i/ /zhabs rdul spyi bos gus len zhing / /za nyal 'chag gis dus 'da' ba'i/ /chos med rnal 'byor gang des sbyar/ /dge 'dis bdag cag dpon slob kyi/ /'di phyi'i don kun 'grub gyur cig /ces dpal gur gyi mgon po'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi lag len don gnyer dga' bskyed bar chad kun sel zhes bya ba 'di'ang sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen paṇ+ḍi ta sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis rang lo nyer gsum lon skabs gdan sa chen po'i chu mig rdzing kha'i bla brang bde mchog pho brang du gur gyi mgon po'i sbyin sreg byas dus sa lo thams cad mkhyen pas mdzad pa'i sbyin sreg gi yig cha nang bzhin las cung zad mi gsal ba rnams sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal pos byas 'gyur sgrub chen dge slong kun dgas sbyin sreg byas dus gnang ba'i gsal byed kyi yig chung gzhir bzhag ste smin rgyas bgyis skabs kyi lag len gyi rim pa rnams rang gi mchod g.yog pa dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa ngag dbang dpal bzang gis zin thor btab 'dug pa la slar yang gsal byed dgos pa 'ga' zhig bsnan cing shin tu dag par byas pa 'di ni rang gi bgrang gzhi bcu phrag bzhi dang nyag ma gnyis su slebs pa sa pho stag gi khrums kyi zla ba'i dmar cha dga' ba gsum pa'i tshes la dpal sa skya'i chos grwa chen po'i bzhi thog bla brang du sbyar ba'i skul ba po ni gong gi mchod g.yog pa de nyid dang /

gzhan yang dus kyi 'khor lo'i rtsis gzhung rgya mtsho lta bu sogs rig gnas mtha' dag la mi 'jigs pa'i spobs pa thob pa chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis kyang nye bar bskul zhing yi ge'i rkyen sbyar te grub par byas pa'o/ /'dis kyang bdag cag dpon slob kyi 'di phyi'i bsam don thams cad yid bzhin du grub ste sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po yab sras rnams kyi bstan pa rin po che mchog tu 'phel ba'i mthu dang ldan pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ //sarba dā oṃ// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ dpal gur gyi mgon po'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi lag len/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
